name: patterns-copy-and-clear
about: ENGINE.md §21 (D133; R86, R90). Pattern 1: effect 2 on step 3 by an edit; write on; kick steps 1 and 7 by keys at the sliders' middles, A to 20000, step 11 (it keeps 20000, 32768). Write + pattern + key 4 copies pattern 1 to pattern 4, lane and kept values with it (R90: effects copy), and write mode goes back to on. Pattern 4 chosen; step 13 added there. Pattern 1 chosen and cleared (function + pattern): only it empties, its lane too (used 0008). Pattern 4 chosen, write off, played: the copy and its own step (ticks 672, 1248, 1632, 1824), last hit at (20000, 32768). Effect 2 is a sound effect: no trace moves for it.
